name: Ticket buttons for The Events Calendar
author: Jeroen Schmit

sections.description:
Add a tickets button to your events in The Events Calendar to allow ticket sales on external websites (eg. your existing ticketing solution).

Need more features?

Now is your chance! Please let me know in the forum and I will see what I can do.
sections.changelog:
1.2.2

  • Added Jeero import sync for ticket button prices and ticket URL.

1.2.1

  • Fixed compatibility with TEC versions that do not support event series.

1.2

  • Added support series.

1.1

  • Added support for multiple prices per event.
  • Added support for block themes.

1.0

  • Ticket buttons for The Events Calendar is born!
